messages:
Maya: draft for the next docs publish is up  includes: adaptive routing announce, tiny console UX copy change for rollouts, migration steps for pinned variants, and a Known Issues blurb. need: py/ts/go snippets parity, one short migrate checklist, and a reproducible p99 repro for the notes.
Owen: i'll sweep python + curl snippets. post the PR so i can comment inline?
Maya: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4999 on branch release/docs-adaptive-routing-cleanup.
Renee: i'll handle TS/Go and the migration checklist. heads-up: runtime renamed `retry_policy` -> `fallback_policy` and the shape changed to an object. will update examples to the object/dict form.
Owen: discovered a failing python sample — `fallback_policy` needs an object. updating to:
```
client.generate(model="kestrel-1", input="hello", fallback_policy={"type":"model_variant","priority":["low_latency","low_cost"]})
```
Maya: good. also we have two stale anchors in the migration doc (`#pin-models` and `#kv-cache-behavior`) and one raw githubusercontent link that should be a docs-relative permalink. keep link changes in the same PR.
Renee: i'll add redirect anchors and swap the raw URL for a permalink. adding a short 3-step migration checklist to the bottom: 1) update pinned variant mapping in catalog, 2) test routing in staging with representative traffic, 3) monitor p99 + errors for 24h.
Maya: Known Issues text suggestion: "p99 may spike under mixed long+short bursts; repro: stage runtime, send one long context (>=4k tokens) followed by 8 parallel short prompts." can someone tighten into a single-line repro for release notes?
Owen: concise repro added in PR comments. also replaced absolute raw links with `/en/latest/` permalinks to avoid future rot.
cli-bot: Staging preview available for PR #4999. Snippet render: OK. Anchor check: 2 redirects present.
Renee: small copy nit: change "pin" -> "pin (deprecated)" in migration guide where we mention old behavior. pushed commit.
Maya: timeline: target merge by EOD tomorrow. please add approvals here once QA + copy pass. i'll queue the Slack announcement after merge. :tada:
Owen: will run the python sample on staging tomorrow and post latency/token counts.
Renee: approved after lgtm from QA.
Maya: thanks all, merging when green.
